learn.explanation:
**Phrasal verb** = fiil + edat/zarf (particle). Anlamı çoğu zaman parçalardan tahmin edilemez.

- **get on** = iyi anlaşmak (≠ get + on)
- **make up** = barışmak (≠ make + up)

**1. Nesnesiz (intransitive) phrasal verbs:** Arkalarından nesne gelmez.

| Phrasal verb | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **fall out** | We **fell out**. |
| **make up** | We **made up** the next day. |
| **break up / split up** | They **broke up** last year. |
| **grow apart** | We slowly **grew apart**. |
| **settle down** | They want to **settle down**. |

**2. Nesne eklemek için genellikle bir edat daha gelir:**

| Nesnesiz | Nesneli |
|---|---|
| We fell out. | I fell out **with** Can. |
| They broke up. | She broke up **with** him. |
| We get on well. | I get on well **with** my boss. |
| We made up. | I made up **with** my brother. |

**İlişki hikâyesi sırası:** ask sb out → go out with → (fall out → make up) → settle down / **break up**

examples.en: I don't get on with my flatmate.
They split up after ten years together.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "anlaşmak", "küsmek", "barışmak" tek kelimedir; İngilizcede bunlar phrasal verb'lerle karşılanır. En sık hata, nesne eklerken "with" edatını unutmaktır: "I don't get on my boss" yanlıştır; doğrusu "I don't get on with my boss". "Biriyle çıkmak" da "go out with" olur; "go out" tek başına "dışarı çıkmak" demektir.

lessons.title: Onu davet etti, onu reddetti
lessons.goal: Ayrılabilen phrasal verb'lerde nesneyi doğru yere, özellikle zamiri ortaya koyabilirim.

discover.title: Sosyal medya itirafı
discover.body:
I've had a crush on Deniz from my yoga class for months. Last week, I finally decided to ask her out.

I wrote a long message, read it twenty times, and then deleted it. I was scared she would turn me down. My flatmate told me off for being such a coward and said, "Just call her up!"

So I called her up. My hands were shaking. And guess what? She said yes!

We're meeting on Saturday. I really hope I don't let her down. Please don't tell me what to wear. I've already tried on everything I own.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer delete the message?
options: The writer was scared Deniz would say no.
The writer made a spelling mistake.
questions.explanation: "I was scared she would turn me down."

learn.explanation:
Bazı nesneli phrasal verb'ler **ayrılabilir** (separable): nesne particle'dan **önce ya da sonra** gelebilir.

| Nesne isimse: İKİ YER DE OLUR | Nesne zamirse: SADECE ORTADA |
|---|---|
| He asked **Deniz** out. ✓ | He asked **her** out. ✓ |
| He asked out **Deniz**. ✓ | ~~He asked out her.~~ ✗ |
| She turned **the offer** down. ✓ | She turned **it** down. ✓ |
| She turned down **the offer**. ✓ | ~~She turned down it.~~ ✗ |

**Altın kural:** **it, him, her, them, me, you, us** her zaman **fiil ile particle'ın arasına** girer.

**Sık kullanılan ayrılabilen phrasal verbs:**

| Phrasal verb | Anlam | Zamirle |
|---|---|---|
| **ask sb out** | çıkma teklif etmek | ask **her** out |
| **turn sth/sb down** | reddetmek | turn **it** down |
| **let sb down** | hayal kırıklığına uğratmak | let **them** down |
| **tell sb off** | azarlamak | tell **him** off |
| **call sb up** | telefonla aramak | call **me** up |
| **bring sb up** | yetiştirmek | bring **them** up |
| **cheer sb up** | neşelendirmek | cheer **her** up |

**Uzun nesneler** genellikle sona gider: *She turned down **the job offer from the bank in London**.*

examples.en: I called him up, but he didn't answer.
They offered her a job, but she turned it down.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede nesne fiilden önce gelir ("onu reddetti"), ama phrasal verb'lerde bölünme fikri yoktur. Türkçe konuşanların en sık yaptığı hata "turn down it", "ask out her" gibi yapılardır. Ezber cümle: "Turn it down, pick it up, let me down". Zamir her zaman ortada!

lessons.title: Örnek almak, katlanmak
lessons.goal: Ayrılamayan ve üç parçalı phrasal verb'leri doğru yapıda kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Bir röportajdan: "Dedem benim kahramanım"
discover.body:
"I've always looked up to my grandfather. He was a fisherman in Sinop, and he looked after his six younger brothers and sisters after his father died. He was only fifteen.

People say I take after him. We're both stubborn, and we both love the sea.

When I was a teenager, I went through a difficult time. My parents had split up, and I was angry with everyone. My grandfather never told me off. He just took me fishing every weekend and listened. Slowly, I opened up to him. He helped me get over it.

He died last year, at 92. I still can't believe he's gone, but I know I can always count on the lessons he taught me."

questions.explanation: "he looked after his six younger brothers and sisters"

He sent the speaker to a doctor.
questions.explanation: "He just took me fishing every weekend and listened."

learn.explanation:
**Ayrılamayan (inseparable) phrasal verbs:** Nesne (isim ya da zamir) **her zaman sonra** gelir.

| Phrasal verb | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **look after** | bakmak | She looks after **him**. (~~looks him after~~) |
| **take after** | çekmek | I take after **my mum**. |
| **get over** | atlatmak | He got over **it**. |
| **run into** | rastlamak | I ran into **her** yesterday. |
| **count on** | güvenmek | You can count on **me**. |
| **go through** | (zor bir dönem) yaşamak | She's going through **a hard time**. |
| **stand by** | yanında olmak | They stood by **him**. |

**Üç parçalı (three-part) phrasal verbs:** Her zaman ayrılamaz.

| Phrasal verb | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **look up to** | örnek almak | I look up to **her**. |
| **put up with** | katlanmak | I can't put up with **it**. |
| **get on with** | iyi anlaşmak | I get on with **them**. |
| **catch up with** | yetişmek; hasret gidermek | Let's catch up with **Ali**. |
| **fall out with** | bozuşmak | She fell out with **him**. |
| **look down on** | küçük görmek | Don't look down on **people**. |

**Nasıl ayırt edilir?** Sözlükler genellikle **look after sb** (ayrılamaz) ve **turn sth down** (ayrılabilir) biçiminde gösterir: **sb/sth'nin yeri** ipucudur.

examples.en: Who looks after your kids when you're at work?

It took me a year to get over it.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "babasına çekmek", "birine katlanmak", "bir şeyi atlatmak" gibi fiiller tek parçadır ve doğru hal ekiyle kullanılır. İngilizce karşılıklarında bu hal eki işlevini particle görür; bu yüzden particle hiç atlanmamalıdır: "I can't put up him" yanlıştır; "I can't put up with him" doğrudur. Ayrıca "take after" sadece aileden birine benzemek için kullanılır.

learn.explanation:
Birçok phrasal verb'ün **birden fazla anlamı** vardır. Anlamı **bağlam** belirler.

| Phrasal verb | Anlam 1 | Anlam 2 | Anlam 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **pick up** | (yerden) almak | (birini arabayla) almak | (dil/beceri) kolayca öğrenmek |
| **take up** | (hobi) başlamak | (yer/zaman) kaplamak | |
| **bring up** | (çocuk) yetiştirmek | (konu) açmak | |
| **work out** | spor yapmak | (bir sorunu) çözmek | iyi sonuçlanmak |
| **turn up** | (beklenmedik) gelmek, ortaya çıkmak | (ses) açmak | |
| **make up** | barışmak | (hikâye) uydurmak | (bir bütünü) oluşturmak |
| **go off** | (alarm) çalmak | (yiyecek) bozulmak | (birinden) soğumak |

**Örnekler:**

- I **picked up** some Spanish in Mexico. (öğrendim)
- Can you **pick me up** at eight? (arabayla almak)
- I **worked out** the answer. (çözdüm) / I **work out** at the gym. (spor yapıyorum)
- Things didn't **work out** between us. (yürümedi)
- He **made up** an excuse. (uydurdu)

**Strateji:** Bilmediğiniz bir phrasal verb'le karşılaşınca önce cümlenin konusuna bakın: ilişki, iş, spor, yemek?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede de "almak" fiilinin pek çok anlamı vardır (ders almak, haber almak, birini arabayla almak). İngilizcedeki pick up da benzer şekilde çalışır. Bilmediğiniz bir phrasal verb'ü kelime kelime çevirmeye çalışmak yerine bağlama bakın: "Things didn't work out" ifadesinin sporla bir ilgisi yoktur!

lessons.title: Dert ortağı
lessons.goal: Phrasal verb ile resmî karşılıkları arasında üslup seçimi yapabilir ve bir tavsiye köşesine samimi ama dengeli bir cevap yazabilirim.

discover.title: Tavsiye köşesi
discover.body:
Dear Ayla,

My best friend and I have known each other since primary school, but recently we've been growing apart. She's started going out with a new group of people and she hardly ever calls me. Last month she didn't turn up to my birthday dinner. I feel she has let me down, but I don't want to lose her. What should I do?

Berna, 24

—

Dear Berna,

I'm sorry you're going through this. It's painful when a close friendship starts to change.

First, try not to jump to conclusions. Your friend might be dealing with something you don't know about. Call her up and suggest meeting for coffee, just the two of you, so you can catch up properly.

When you meet, be honest. Tell her that you felt hurt when she didn't come to your birthday, but don't tell her off. Ask her how she's feeling.

Friendships change as we get older. That doesn't always mean they end. But if she doesn't make an effort, it may be time to let go and invest in people you can really count on.

Ayla

learn.explanation:
**Phrasal verb mi, tek kelimelik fiil mi?**

Phrasal verb'ler **günlük, samimi** dildir. Resmî yazıda (iş e-postası, rapor, makale) genellikle **Latin kökenli tek kelimelik** fiiller tercih edilir.

| Phrasal verb (samimi) | Tek kelime (resmî) |
|---|---|
| put up with | **tolerate** |
| turn down | **reject / decline** |
| look after | **care for / take care of** |
| find out | **discover** |
| bring up (a topic) | **raise / mention** |
| make up (with sb) | **reconcile** |
| split up / break up | **separate** |
| go through (a difficult time) | **experience** |
| look up to | **admire** |
| put off | **postpone** |

**Örnek:**

- Samimi: *I can't **put up with** my neighbour's noise.*
- Resmî: *Residents should not have to **tolerate** excessive noise.*

**Tavsiye köşesi cevabı nasıl yazılır?**

1. **Empati:** *I'm sorry you're going through this.*
2. **Durumu farklı açıdan görme:** *Your friend might be ...*
3. **Somut adımlar:** *Call her up and ... / When you meet, ...*
4. **Dengeli bir kapanış:** *If ..., it may be time to ...*

examples.en: I'm sorry you're going through this.
The company rejected the proposal. (= turned it down)
We had to postpone the meeting. (= put it off)

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede resmî ve samimi dil arasındaki fark genellikle hitap ve fiil ekleriyle yapılır ("yaparsınız" / "yaparsın"). İngilizcede ise kelime seçimi önemlidir: Bir iş e-postasında "We turned down your offer" yerine "We have decided to decline your offer" yazmak çok daha profesyonel durur. Konuşmada ise tek kelimelik fiiller fazla resmî ve soğuk gelebilir.

task.prompt: Bir dergi tavsiye köşesine gelen aşağıdaki mektuba cevap yazın (150–200 kelime): "I've been living with my flatmate for two years. We used to get on really well, but now he never tidies up, he brings friends home late at night, and he forgets to pay his share of the bills. I don't want to fall out with him, but I can't put up with it any more. Can." Empatiyle başlayın, en az 6 phrasal verb kullanın, somut adımlar önerin ve dengeli bir kapanış yapın.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Can,

I'm sorry you're going through this. Sharing a flat with someone you used to get on with can be really hard when things start to change.

First of all, don't let things build up any longer. The longer you put up with it, the angrier you'll become. Choose a calm moment and bring the problems up honestly, but don't tell him off. Start by asking if everything is OK with him. He might be going through a difficult time that you don't know about.

Then be specific. Suggest a simple cleaning rota and agree on some house rules about guests on weeknights. For the bills, you could set up a shared account so neither of you has to remember.

If he makes an effort, great. You can stay friends and flatmates. But if he keeps letting you down, it might be time to look for a new place. A good friendship is worth more than a cheap flat.

Good luck,
Ayla

questions.prompt: Hayatınızda zaman içinde değişen bir ilişkiyi anlatın (bir arkadaşlık, bir aile bağı, bir iş ilişkisi) (150–200 kelime). En az 8 farklı phrasal verb kullanın: ayrılabilen (zamirle), ayrılamayan ve üç parçalı türlerden en az ikişer tane olsun.
questions.modelAnswer:
My cousin Kerem and I were brought up almost like brothers. We lived on the same street, and our mothers looked after us together while our fathers were at work. Everyone said I took after him, because we were both noisy and full of energy.

When we were teenagers, though, we started to grow apart. He took up football and I took up music, and we had different friends. Then, at nineteen, we fell out badly. He borrowed my guitar and broke it, and he made up a silly story about how it happened. I told him off in front of the whole family, and we didn't speak for three years.

I only got over it when I heard he was going through a hard time after losing his job. I called him up and asked if he wanted to meet. We caught up over dinner, apologised, and made up.

Today, he's one of the people I can always count on. I've realised that I don't just love him. I look up to him, because he never lets down the people he loves.
